description: Deletes one rule that decides how a platform's notices are read and routed, as the rule editor's Delete does. The rule is not minted back by the registry reconcile (the delete leaves a tombstone). It cannot be undone; add a rule again to replace it. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat after it is gone answers success.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: delete_platform_email_rule
title: Delete a platform email rule
